title: LITS Canonical Representation
description: Rectangle grid pre-divided into regions by thick borders; player shades one L/I/T/S tetromino per region

h.description: (m-1) x n array: h[r][c] = thick border below cell[r][c]. 0=thin, 1=thick

v.description: m x (n-1) array: v[r][c] = thick border right of cell[r][c]. 0=thin, 1=thick
